files_modified.summary: Extended check_cross_agent() function with 120+ lines of POI time conflict detection logic

git_rationale.root_cause: check_cross_agent() function lacked POI time conflict detection. Validation was limited to structural consistency (day counts, dates, locations, budget sums) but did not detect content-level scheduling conflicts where same POI or different POIs with identical/overlapping times appeared across multiple agent files.
git_rationale.root_cause_commit: No specific commit - validation gap exists since plan-validate.py creation
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: check_cross_agent() was designed for structural consistency validation, not content-level conflict detection. POI time overlaps were considered an edge case not initially addressed in validation design.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Added comprehensive POI time conflict detection that: (1) Collects all POIs with time data from attractions, entertainment, shopping, meals per day, (2) Compares all POI pairs across different agents, (3) Detects identical times (HIGH if both non-optional, INFO if optional), (4) Detects overlapping times (MEDIUM severity). This addresses root cause by extending validation from structural to content-level conflict detection.

validation_rules.condition: start1 == start2 AND end1 == end2 AND NOT opt1 AND NOT opt2
validation_rules.message_format: IDENTICAL TIME CONFLICT: '{name1}' ({agent1}) and '{name2}' ({agent2}) both scheduled at {time} (both non-optional)

validation_rules.rule: RULE 1b: Identical Time + At Least One Optional
validation_rules.condition: start1 == start2 AND end1 == end2 AND (opt1 OR opt2)
validation_rules.message_format: Identical time (optional): '{name1}' ({agent1}) and '{name2}' ({agent2}) at {time} (at least one is optional)

validation_rules.condition: start1 < end2 AND start2 < end1 (and NOT identical)

error_handling: Skip POI if time field missing or not dict type
Skip POI if time.start or time.end missing
Skip POI if time values are empty strings
Use .get('optional', False) to handle missing optional field (default: False = non-optional)
